problem: Seven of 25 questions were Judge-wrong in all three valid v10 runs and never retrieved a gold document. Retrieval-query generation is already frozen after prior registered rejections, but it is not yet established whether the local corpus actually contains a literal answer in the registered gold documents.
simplest_baseline: Classify every zero-gold-recall case as a retriever miss. That is unsafe if the indexed gold document is absent or the benchmark answer is not literally recoverable from its text.
hypothesis: At least five of the seven persistent misses have an indexed gold document containing the normalized literal answer. If so, the dominant next problem remains retrieval visibility rather than corpus absence or answer-label mismatch.
anti_claim: This is a posthoc development diagnostic using gold labels. It does not improve retrieval, answer accuracy, or model capability.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Neither delegation nor another role can recover evidence that is absent from the indexed corpus; corpus answerability must be established first.
Switching search tools is premature until the audit separates local index absence from ranking failure.
More crawling is justified only for corpus-absent cases; answer-bearing indexed documents instead require retrieval changes.
Parallel expansion is expensive when the immediate uncertainty is whether a target document exists locally and contains the answer at all.

frozen_controls: exact seven persistent_retrieval_miss IDs from the three-run audit
same development gold slice and local document index
next_action: Keep corpus expansion and multi-agent orchestration deferred. Compare gold-document BM25 ranks for the raw full question and every recorded model-generated query on the identical index; test whether a deterministic raw-question anchor is the simplest missing retrieval channel.
claim_boundary: A result of at least five answerable cases selects retrieval/index diagnosis as the next layer. It is not an effectiveness result and cannot reopen the frozen query-generation branch by itself.
